div.span: Team computer: data preparation, run by hand per snapshot

ARGUS API
[External system]
api.argusservices.athenarc.gr/api
paged JSON: data[], meta.last_page, meta.total
15 records per page, oldest first

ARGUS 3D data
[External system]
argus.athenarc.gr: Cesium terrain
(layer.json), 3D Tiles (tileset.json)

Esri, OpenStreetMap,
AWS Terrain Tiles
[External systems]

Supabase
[External system, optional]
not configured today

Snapshot fetcher
[Python 3.9+ script, standard library]
tools/fetch_snapshot.py
12 resources, every page

3D fetcher
[Python script]
tools/fetch_argus_3d.py
≤ 8 MB per place

Narration recorder
[Node script]
npm run narration

Repository
[Git, private on GitHub]
code, snapshot_2026-10-12,
content, game data, 3D scenes, audio

Build and publish pipeline
[GitHub Actions: site.yml]
tests → build → live copy → publish
on push to main, nightly 23:00 UTC, by hand

Website
[Static files on GitHub Pages, HTTPS]
site branch: the built app,
data packs, live/argus-now.json

Live reader
[Python service, systemd timer, own sandboxed user]
guardian_live.py, every 2 hours
threat-contexts and events, new pages only

Live file
[JSON, about 22 KB]
argus-now.json, state.json

Live file server
[Caddy + playit.gg tunnel]
serves /live/argus-now.json only

Web game
[Single-page app in the browser: React 18,
TypeScript, Leaflet, three.js; service worker]
map, missions, alarms, scores, 3D view

Device storage
[localStorage]
settings, choices, quiz answers,
leaderboard, observation reports

Class server (optional)
[Python, tools/class_server.py]
teacher's computer, same network,
anonymous records in class_data/

GET /api/{resource}?page=N
[HTTP, JSON, 0.25 s apart,
4 tries with back-off]

GET tiles, HEAD for sizes
[HTTPS, robots.txt respected]
writes one JSON file per resource

triggers on push to main
[GitHub webhook]

GET /api/threat-contexts?page=N
GET /api/events?page=N
[HTTP, JSON, 0.5 s apart, ≤ 400 pages,
3 tries, 30 s timeout]

force-pushes one commit
to the site branch [git, HTTPS]

reads live/argus-now.json
[HTTPS, ≤ every 10 min, 8 s timeout]
